summary: This opening Paradiso livestream extends the Great Books lens by making imagination the method of truth, Paradise a training ground for paradox and will, Piccarda a self-authored station of fear-shaped desire, and forgiveness the force that restores agency where self-justification makes hell.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: the soul is not dragged toward God by force, nor sentenced by arbitrary weights; it drifts, rises, stalls, or hides according to what it truly wants
existing_lens_links.rationale: The June 15 lecture gives the later Paradiso version of chosen hell: heaven's graded spheres expose desire and refusal rather than external sentencing.
The closing adultery and forgiveness discussion restates the self-made-hell anchor in ordinary moral psychology: the self cannot command its way out of the worldview that justified betrayal.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: the imagination is what will lead you to the truth
existing_lens_links.rationale: This source makes the Dante reading method explicit: paradox and poetic compression force imagination past ordinary logic and school-trained critique.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: logic are like chains ... imagination is like a bird
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source gives a Great Books classroom recurrence of escape practice: ordinary logic remains useful for school but becomes confinement when Paradise requires another mode of knowing.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this June 15, 2026 Paradiso opening as the latest visible Dante free-will layer after the April 8, April 29, and May 22 Dante lectures: free choice is the fundamental law of the universe, God is constant welcome rather than cosmic police, Piccarda's lower sphere reflects fear-shaped desire, and forgiveness interrupts self-made hell.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns self-authored spiritual station, chosen cleansing, and forgiveness as restored agency. Human Heart owns forgiveness as a social or civilizational test; Love Recognizes owns concrete relation when recognition of the beloved is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the opening method passage when Poetry next compresses the Dante layer: Paradise is entered by imagination, intuition, paradox, ambiguity, and economy, not by exam logic alone; poetry translates a higher order into words that limited minds can inhabit.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the literary and perceptual method. Free Will owns the moral burden the method reveals; Dead World owns the cave escape function when the contrast is against school/material reality.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold this source as a Great Books escape-practice recurrence: Jiang explicitly contrasts school logic, test-taking, and ordinary earthly categories with intuition and imagination as the faculties needed to enter a living universe.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Dead World owns the escape-from-false-material-reality mechanism. Education owns school formation only when the institutional game itself is primary; Poetry owns Dante's form and method.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as boundary pressure for education: Jiang attacks logic as a test-passing habit and asks students to change their instrument of knowing, but the active source mechanism is Dante/Paradiso formation rather than a general school-system diagnosis.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Do not append ordinary anti-school prose to Education from this source. Route public use through Poetry or Dead World unless a later classroom cluster makes Paradise reading method part of a broader education compression.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the imagination-makes-heaven and metaphor-as-ontology material as background only: it resembles Jiang's broader imagination/reality claims, but this source is about spiritual reading and free will, not power installing an abstraction as social reality.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns imagination when elites train an invented form into coercive reality. This source should stay with Poetry, Dead World, and Free Will unless a later comparison turns metaphor-as-ontology into a political conversion mechanism.

new_lens_seeds.title: Paradise As Imagination Training
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Paradise is not passive reward scenery but a pedagogical realm where paradox, symbolic plurality, dialogue, and self-authored desire train the reader to know through imagination and will.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could organize later Paradiso sources without creating a generic Dante topic page, but the current public map can still route the pieces through Poetry, Free Will, Dead World, and Guide Trap.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed only. Do not create standalone Paradise, Piccarda, Dante Livestream, Beatrice, Apollo, or Christian Line pages from this source alone.

chronology_notes.note: This is dated 2026-06-15 and is the opening session of the two-week Dante workshop, processed after several later Great Books Dante sources. Public synthesis should preserve source date: it follows the May 22 Purgatorio public chronology and gives a new later Paradiso opening layer, not an earlier foundation.

The source explicitly turns chronology into meaning inside the lecture: Jiang separates Dante's medieval world from the first-century crucifixion, then says Christianity changes pagan circular recurrence into a historical line where individual agency matters.

The June 15 source gives a later free-will formulation than the April and May Dante lectures already public on Free Will: God does not assign spiritual weight externally; the soul's own desire, fear, and readiness determine its place.

next_actions.action: No immediate public page edit is required in this compact intake. The strongest next public move is a Free Will replacement/compression pass that adds the June 15 Paradiso layer to the existing Dante chronology without making a standalone Paradise or Piccarda page.

If provenance links are applied later, link only the exact marks for imagination-as-truth, self-authored weight, will finding a way, and self-made hell/forgiveness to existing anchors; avoid bulk-linking every Dante, Paradise, Piccarda, or heaven passage.

Before any public Paradise As Imagination Training seed promotion, compare this opening livestream with the existing May 27 Dante in Paradise impact and any later livestreams so the seed does not duplicate Poetry, Free Will, Dead World, or Guide Trap.
